title: Stepanov gives a FIXED-r theorem the Weil/AG route cannot (Betti wall): the order-2 auxiliary already beats r(c)≤2 universally over any field — push the vanishing order, not the moment depth
connection: The two routes to the deep moments are OPPOSITE on the depth parameter. The AG/GLT modified-Fermat route (W-Betti) computes E_r as a point-count whose Betti B_prim=((d−1)^{2r}+(d−1))/d grows EXPONENTIALLY in r, capping at r=2. The Stepanov route does the opposite: it bounds the SAME object at FIXED low order by raising the auxiliary's VANISHING multiplicity M, paying only deg≈n per unit of M (stepanov_card_mul_M_le_natDegree: |V|·M≤deg Ψ). The explicit Q=(c−X)^{n+1}+X^{n+1}−c (repCount_two_mul_le_of_pow_ne_one) ALREADY gives r(c)≤(n+1)/2 over any field incl. the split prize; repCount_two_mul_le_of_even sharpens to r(c)≤n/2 on even-n NTT — char-p theorems with no Betti/conductor dependence. generic_stepanov_degree_ge proves the leverage must come from the A=μ_n∩(c+μ_n) degeneracy where BOTH x^n=1 and (x−c)^n=1, exactly what Q exploits.
why_insightful: Reframes the dead 'push past r=2' AG plan: the obstruction (Betti grows in r) is precisely the parameter Stepanov does NOT need to grow. Stepanov fixes r and pushes M — so the Betti wall that kills the AG route is not a wall for Stepanov. The campaign filed Stepanov under 'ruled out' but that referred to the GENERIC dimension count; the special-form A-degeneracy auxiliary is a different live object.
attack_plan: Build the order-3 confluent auxiliary by analogy to Q: seek Ψ vanishing to order 3 at every y∈A=μ_n∩(c+μ_n) with deg Ψ≈n, giving r(c)≤(n+1)/3. Lean: repCount_three_mul_le : 3·r(c)≤deg Ψ≤n+O(1). If the order-M family exists with deg Ψ=O(n+M²), optimizing M gives r(c)≤O(n^{2/3}), E_p≤O(n^{8/3}) — a FIXED-r-free char-p energy bound the AG route cannot produce. Probe first: numerically search for the order-3 auxiliary at μ_8/F_p.
